## Description {#details}

Struct template representing a generic integral constant.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="N">The compile-time constant value.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/integral-constant">integral&#95;constant</a></code> struct template provides a compile-time constant value of an integral type, with additional utility features. It inherits from <code>op</code> to enable unified handling within the µTest++ framework&#39;s type traits and metaprogramming utilities.

This struct template exposes the constant value via a static member, a getter method, and explicit conversion operators. It also provides a unary minus operator to obtain the negative value as a new <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/integral-constant">integral&#95;constant</a></code> instance.

Definition at line 703 of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits-h">type-traits.h</a>.
